import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    
    memo = [[None] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    
    sys.setrecursionlimit(10000)
    
    def dp(i, j):
        if memo[i][j] is not None:
            return memo[i][j]
        if i == 0 and j == 0:
            res = 1
        elif i == 0:
            res = dp(i, j - 1)
        elif i == j:
            res = dp(i - 1, j)
        else:
            res = (dp(i, j - 1) + dp(i - 1, j)) % MOD
        memo[i][j] = res
        return res
    
    ans = 0
    for j in range(n + 1):
        for i in range(j):
            if ((i + j) & 1) == 1:
                ans = (ans + dp(i, j)) % MOD
    
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
